parent_sanity: deadlock (iteration 1 of 200; ErrHandler's cc.Closed() blocks on the sub lock held by the caller)
notes: Starts embedded nats-server (needs go get github.com/nats-io/nats-server/v2@v2.15.2 in the worktree). Inputs op (trigger: nc.Close vs DeleteConsumer; handler action Closed/Stop/Drain; second goroutine Closed/Stop/Publish), nmsgs, payload. DeleteConsumer is issued only after a message was received (or consuming ended), else the pull may not be registered and Consume never terminates.
